facts.business: Sam Industries Limited operates through two segments: Real Estate Division focused on residential and commercial projects in Madhya Pradesh, and Investment Division with investments in power generation, auto tyres, pharmaceuticals, and other sectors.
key_risks: Market risk from reduction in value of investments
Fall in returns due to dip in investee company performance
Adverse impact on invested industries (power, auto tyres, pharmaceuticals, etc.)
Changes in government regulations and tax regimes
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 and details have been disclosed in financial statements as required by applicable Indian accounting standards.
